name: TunTunWorld
detailed_description:
Welcome to TunTunWorld!

This is a 3D action game like nothing you've ever seen before.

You'll control a mysterious creature called TunTun as you progress through the game.

At its core, it’s a simple third-person 3D action game.

TunTun’s main ability is to poke things. He goes around poking objects around him!

By poking, various reactions are triggered in the environment.

Using these reactions, you’ll find your way forward.

Other actions include jumping and grabbing objects.

With "Jump," TunTun climbs to reach new areas and explore the world.

With "Grab," you can carry key items and activate unique mechanisms.

By using these abilities, you’ll gradually explore the map and solve its mysteries.

If you solve all the puzzles, you’ll clear the game.

So get poking and move forward into the unknown!

short_description: TunTunWorld is a 3D action game with a third-person perspective. Players control a character to explore the map, using three main actions: poke, grab, and jump. By investigating various areas, they can uncover and solve mysteries. The ultimate goal is to solve every puzzle and clear the game.
